description.value: Vanessa Vineyard is a boutique estate winery perched on the rocky hillside of the Similkameen Valley in Cawston, growing premium red wine grapes on 75 acres of sloping, mineral-rich terrain along the Crowsnest Highway. Named for the Greek word for butterfly, the estate has earned national recognition for bold reds crafted under Master Winemaker Howard Soon, an Order of Canada recipient. The on-site tasting room offers curated guided experiences, making it a compelling destination for cyclists touring one of Canada's most scenic wine corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was fully accessible and consistent with OSM data. The tasting room page confirms the address (1090 Highway 3, Cawston, BC V0X 1C3) and phone (+1 250-499-8811), both matching OSM values. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags, so all those fields are null.
concerns: OSM lists the street as 'Crowsnest Highway'; website consistently uses 'Highway 3' — same road, different name convention. Website value used as it is more complete (includes city and postal code).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Vanessa Vineyard is a well-established, award-winning winery with an active tasting room directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest Highway), a popular touring cycling route through the Similkameen Valley — a strong destination listing even without confirmed cyclist amenities.
